title: yatsude flow manifest (flow.yaml)
description: Sits next to a flow's SKILL.md. SKILL.md stays the text the agent follows; flow.yaml is what tools and CI check: the units, the slots, what the flow may do, and where it stops for a person.

name.description: Same as the folder and the SKILL.md name.

version.description: The flow's own version. Bump it when its steps, stops or effects change.

trust.description: core: shipped and maintained here. reviewed: a community flow a maintainer reviewed. experimental: a community flow that may not lean on the charter; every risky effect needs a stop.

yatsude.description: The yatsude versions it works with, as a semver range (e.g. ">=0.21").

config.description: The flow config sections it reads (e.g. Repo, Load limits, <tasks>).

steps.description: Units that run as steps, in order. Must match the body's `Steps, in order:` list.

throughout.description: Units any step may call. Must match the body's `Throughout:` list.

name.description: A slot with a contract in delegate's references/slots.md.

via.description: The unit the slot runs inside (review-change, ui-check, delegate).

default.description: The unit that fills it when the user plugs nothing in, if there is one.

effects.description: What the flow's own steps do, beyond what its units declare (e.g. the flow pushes and merges itself).

stops.description: Where the flow waits for a person. One per Stop marker in the body (**Stop and ask** or **N. Stop:**).

after.description: The step unit it comes after, or "start".

guards.description: The risky effects that wait on this stop.

asks.description: What the person decides here, in one line.

charter.description: Risky effects the flow may take without a stop when the user's charter grants them; with no grant it asks first. Empty for experimental flows.

on_failure.description: True when the body has a `## When a step fails` section.
